title: Regulating Act of 1773
definition: The first legislative step taken by the British Government to control and regulate the affairs of the East India Company (EIC) in India, marking the transition from a commercial body to a political-administrative entity.
importanceInUpsc: It is the foundational act of the British constitutional history in India, frequently tested for its role in centralizing administration and establishing the Supreme Court.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Regulating Act.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
